logos.prompt: Refine the EXACT supplied Dum E Odisha logo while retaining its recognisable base idea. This is NOT a different style or new identity. Keep the soft rounded lowercase 'dum' in saffron #ECAA35, a separate rounded lowercase 'e' in deep chilli #A63825, the lifted cooking lid integrated above 'dum', and uppercase ODISHA below in chilli. Retain the original rice-grain idea in the d counter. Main improvements: an unmistakable actual cream gap between m and e, optically equal stroke weight, open d/u/m/e counters, tidy lid knob and cleaner tip, shorter less distracting m-terminal flourish, no thin fragile hooks. ODISHA is the second half of the name, not tiny descriptor. Carefully designed balance inspired by golden-ratio hierarchy: generous main name, subordinate ODISHA roughly 0.618 of main name width; do not put any grid or measurement labels into the image. No tagline, no added symbols, no BIRYANI text, no 3D, no gradients, no texture or fake shadows. Flat warm cream #FFF3DD background. A single large centered full logo with margins, original playful geometry preserved and made clearer.

Make a carefully refined NEGATIVE-SPACE version of the EXACT supplied Dum E Odisha logo. Preserve the source's distinctive rounded lowercase d-u-m, separate lowercase e, raised cooking lid, saffron/chilli palette and ODISHA beneath. Do not switch to uppercase DUM, a serif, generic font or unrelated emblem. The d counter should be ONE clean cream negative-space rice-kernel shape with subtly pointed tips; remove the separate positive saffron grain floating inside the old counter. The d must still read immediately as d. Define the lifted lid with ONE clear tapered cream negative-space slit between lid and rim, not extra outline strokes. Keep lid above dum, never bridging m to e. Create a conspicuous actual gap between m and e; e deep chilli #A63825, dum and lid warm saffron #ECAA35, ODISHA chilli. Remove the long bird-like m flourish in favour of a short controlled rounded terminal, unify curve tension and optical weight, generous counters. ODISHA about 61.8% of main name width, with clean spacing, golden-ratio-inspired hierarchy but no construction lines in logo image. Flat #FFF3DD cream background, crisp flat ink. No tiny ornaments, tagline, other words, 3D, gradient, shadow or grain. Same base idea, more disciplined and recognisable.

brand.prompt: Create a refined complete food-brand presentation for the supplied exact Dum E Odisha logo. Preserve its recognisable rounded lowercase saffron dum, separate chilli e, rice-kernel negative-space d counter, lifted lid, lid's white slit and uppercase ODISHA beneath. This exact supplied normalized logo is the locked reference. Do not switch to serif, capitals DUM, another icon or different spelling. Landscape 3:2 designer's board: a large clean flat reference-logo proof on the left; coordinated matte rice-cream paper carrier and squat lidded takeaway tub on right; a restrained seal and wrapping-paper sample below; one supporting broad pattern panel derived from lid arcs and rice-grain negative shapes. Palette saffron #ECAA35, chilli #A63825, cream #FFF3DD and dark ink #29231F. Keep yellow as the warm brand artwork and red/ink for readable practical text. Spacious mature composition, purposeful proportions, no busy badges or gold foil. Supporting rice/lid illustrations should feel hand-drawn in flat ink, not glossy 3D. Realistic matte paper/folds and warm natural lighting in mockups. All text ONLY the supplied logo name 'dum e' and 'ODISHA'; no unverified menu, address, slogan, prices, registration or founding-date claims. No construction grid in this application board. This is an exploratory packaging concept, not actual manufactured products.
